items.source: NASA CR-167937 ASE Mod I Vol III, parts lists PDF p.19-20
items.what: 17037 'Cast, generator housing' -> 17038 'Regenerator house ass'y (machining)'; 17035 'Cast cylinder housing' -> 17036 'Cylinder house ass'y (machining)'
items.why: Genuine raw/machined parent-child pairs in the parts lists, but neither the casting nor the machining DRAWINGS (17035-17038) are in the volume (not in the C.3/C.5/C.6 drawing lists, not found on any sheet). Parts-list evidence only.

items.source: NASA CR-167937 Vol III, Hot Engine System PDF p.108, 112, 115
items.what: 2-17020 Gas cooler machining, 3-17018 Cooler housing (SIS 2343 stainless), 3-17021 Gas cooler ass'y
items.why: Fabricated/brazed assembly then machined; housing is wrought stainless, not a casting or forging.

items.source: NASA CR-167937 Vol III, Cold Engine System PDF p.151-156
items.what: 1-17045 Water jacket (2 sheets), 1-17112 / 1-17128 Crosshead guide (SIS 4255 cast Al)
items.why: Single combined cast-and-machined drawings; no separate raw or machining drawing; crosshead guide scans largely illegible.

items.source: NASA CR-167937 Vol III, Engine Drive System PDF p.185-310 (every title block read)
items.what: Connecting rods 1-61101 (S.G. iron), 2-61114 (casting SG iron 37/2), crankshafts 1-61112/1-61113/1-61240 (722M24 En40B), clutch housing 1-61219, intercasing 1-61121, sump 1-61119, water pump body 1-61123, oil filter housing 1-61149 (cast Al LM6), flywheel, gears
items.why: Each is ONE drawing (cast-and-machined or machined-from-bar); no separate casting/forging drawing exists in the volume. Usable as single-stage castings, not as raw/finished pairs.

items.source: NASA CR-167936 ASE Mod I Vol I (NTRS 19820026435) and Vol II (NTRS 19830002721)
items.why: No drawings of raw/finished pairs; Vol I used only for the casting-process statement (pages extracted into the ASE folders). Vol II is controls/auxiliaries text.

items.source: NTRS 19870061507 'Automotive Stirling engine system component review'
items.why: Download returned a non-PDF (JSON/error body); not pursued.

items.source: NTRS 19790003238 Mini-BRU Vol 2 'Figures and drawings' (GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED)
items.why: Figures and photos (e.g. Astroloy turbine wheel machined); no casting/forging drawing paired with a machining drawing.

items.source: DTIC AD0855761 Evaluation of Advanced Gear-Forging Techniques (Sikorsky, 1969; limitation changed to public release 1971)
items.why: Finished detail gear drawing (Fig. 1) only; the as-forged blanks are photographs, no forging drawing.

items.source: DTIC ADA124578 / ADA110326 / ADA393677 CAD/CAM for near-net / net forged spiral bevel gears (Battelle 1981-85)
items.why: Process/die-design reports; preform schematics and photos, no dimensioned forging + machining drawing pair found in the OCR text. Not opened page by page (time).

items.source: DTIC ADA153479 Powder Metallurgy Forged Gear Development (1985); ADA095556 Forging of P/M Gears (1980)
items.why: Powder-forging route (not conventional forging); preform drawing + figure 'relationship between forged shape and machined shape' could be a later candidate; not extracted.

items.source: DTIC ADA028861 Isothermal Forging of Ti-6Al-4V (M85 machine gun cover, 1976)
items.why: References TRW drawing 8851-250-3 'Cover forging' and US Army drawing 7793151 'Finish machined M85 cover' but the report's figures are photos/tooling; the two part drawings are not reproduced. Weapon component; titanium isothermal forging - off-target.

items.source: DTIC ADA151951 Production Methods for Squeeze Castings (IITRI 1978, US Army Missile Command)
items.why: Fig. 3 (PDF p.20) is a half-section of the forward-dome squeeze casting with the machined part outline superimposed - genuine raw+finished in one figure, but sparsely dimensioned and a missile rocket-motor part; kept as a fallback, not extracted.

items.source: DTIC ADA385344 Agile Manufacturing Development of Castings (GE CRD, ONR 2000, Distribution A)
items.why: Casting process / software report (AEGIS tower, AC locomotive, AAAV, Sundstrand housing); pictures of models, no dimensioned as-cast + machined drawing pair seen in OCR text.

items.source: DTIC AD0782965 Endurance test of high-strength cast aluminium transmission case and clutch housing (1974)
items.why: Test report; no drawings in the OCR text.

items.source: OSTI 2320384 ORNL/TM-2023/3051 'Prototyping and manufacturing of magnetic gearbox components using innovations in castings' (Emrgy CRADA)
items.why: Very useful COST reference (Table 1A quoted mould+casting $ and machining $ for 5 sand-cast parts; Table 3 casting v finished weight, e.g. SH020 rotor 383 lb cast / 315 lb machined, $16,635 casting + $18,250 machining) but the only drawing (Fig. 2, SH020 machine drawing) is a thumbnail with illegible dimensions and there is no as-cast drawing. Not a drawing pair; worth recording as cost data separately.

items.source: MIL-STD-100G (DTIC ADA361444) / MIL-STD-100D (ibiblio)
items.why: Looked for worked casting-drawing / machined-casting examples. DTIC returned 'Service unavailable' (not retried around); ibiblio TLS chain failed through the proxy. Not obtained.

items.source: Wikimedia Commons (Rohteil / Schmiedeteil / casting drawing / forging drawing searches)
items.why: Only paintings, patents and HAER photos; no raw/finished drawing pairs. API rate-limited on first attempts.

items.source: GitHub repository search (casting/forging drawing, foundry pattern, open-source engine castings)
items.why: Nothing with a licence and both drawings. RamShankhpal/UGNX--Pully-Casting-Machining has no licence (and is a student exercise) - not used.

items.source: M1 Garand / M1911 ordnance forging drawings
items.why: Only collector/mirror sites of unclear provenance and licence (and weapons); not used.

items.source: archive.org public-domain shop books (Woodworth 1911 'Drop Forging, Die Sinking...'; 'United States Navy drop forging book' 1919)
items.why: Forging/die catalogues, no paired machining drawing of the same part; not opened page by page.

items.source: Drafting textbooks found by archive.org full-text search ('forging drawing' + 'machining drawing')
items.why: In-copyright textbooks (borrow-only); not reusable.

items.source: GrabCAD / Formula Student / NADCA / AFS / ASM worked examples
items.why: Download needs an account, or the material is not openly licensed - not attempted per rules.
